name: vue-design-workspace
description: Schema 驱动的可视化搭建引擎：框架无关 core + Vue / React 适配层 + 示例应用（扩展包在独立仓库维护）

scripts.build: pnpm build:lib && pnpm --filter playground build && pnpm --filter react-demo build
scripts.build:lib: node scripts/release.mjs check && pnpm --filter @x-ac/design-core build && pnpm --filter @x-ac/design-vue build && pnpm --filter @x-ac/design-react build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @x-ac/design-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @x-ac/design-vue typecheck && pnpm --filter @x-ac/design-react typecheck && pnpm --filter playground typecheck && pnpm --filter react-demo typecheck
